name: Airi
source:
An android of the "ROZA TYPE ZERO" series. Working at Dream Club for the purpose of acquiring emotional data through conversations, some of the intelligence she gathers can end up being slightly strange because of the specific working environment she's in. Airi's sentences often end in question marks, since for her, conversation is for the sake of learning.

[spoiler]Her real name is ROZA Type-0-ILI (ROZA零式-ILI).[/spoiler]
